name: Personal Data Encryption
description: Windows MDM settings in the Personal Data Encryption category, applied as OMA-URI (SyncML) values.

properties.name: Enable Personal Data Encryption (User)
properties.description: Allows the Admin to enable Personal Data Encryption. Set to '1' to set this policy.

properties.name: Protect Desktop (User)
properties.description: Allows the Admin to enable Personal Data Encryption on Desktop folder. Set to '1' to set this policy.

enum.description: Disable Personal Data Encryption on the folder. If the folder is currently protected by Personal Data Encryption, this will result in unprotecting the folder.
Enable Personal Data Encryption on the folder.

properties.name: Protect Documents (User)
properties.description: Allows the Admin to enable Personal Data Encryption on Documents folder. Set to '1' to set this policy.

enum.description: Disable Personal Data Encryption on the folder. If the folder is currently protected by Personal Data Encryption, this will result in unprotecting the folder.
Enable Personal Data Encryption on the folder.

properties.name: Protect Pictures (User)
properties.description: Allows the Admin to enable Personal Data Encryption on Pictures folder. Set to '1' to set this policy.

enum.description: Disable Personal Data Encryption on the folder. If the folder is currently protected by Personal Data Encryption, this will result in unprotecting the folder.
Enable Personal Data Encryption on the folder.
